name: Insel Hiddensee (Germany)
description: Vertically divided yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Insel Hiddensee (a seahorse and a cross on yellow and blue).
history: The arms, designed by the Weimar heraldist Michael Zapfe, were approved by the Ministry of the Interior on 29 January 1998; the yellow and blue recall the island's belonging to the Swedish crown from 1648 to 1815.

features.role: Insel Hiddensee arms — seahorse and cross
